reviews.text: I needed a reliable machine for my design work and the trackpad is huge and incredibly responsive. The overall performance has been smooth and I love how the large glass surface makes navigation so effortless. I bought this after my old laptop crashed right in the middle of a big project deadline. Samsung's support team was super helpful when I had a question about setting up the display features. The thin chassis can lead to thermal throttling under heavy sustained loads and the speakers on the base models lack the depth found in the Pro setups.

The build quality feels solid enough for daily tasks, especially considering the price is much better than the competition. I am really disappointed with the experience since the base model uses a standard LCD screen instead of the amazing AMOLED display. Still, the 1080p webcam makes my video calls look crisp which helps a lot when working from home.

after two months the fast charging via usb-c is amazing and the build quality feels premium. i love how quiet it runs when im just browsing the web or typing up documents. the customer service experience was super smooth when i had a quick question about my order. overall the performance is solid even with the soldered ram limiting future upgrades.

I bought this Galaxy Book3 to replace my old laptop for daily work and school tasks. The laptop runs incredibly quiet even when I am working hard, and the 1080p webcam makes my video calls look crystal clear. Unfortunately, the standard LCD screen on my base model reflects too much light in my bright home office.

I absolutely love this Galaxy Book3 because the 1080p webcam is a total game changer for my daily video calls. The price point is pretty fair considering the performance you get with these newer Intel chips. I've been using it mostly for work during the week and just catching up on shows on the weekends. If you can find a deal on the standard model it might be a better value than the Pro versions with the pricier screens. Just keep in mind that the battery life gets a bit shaky when you run the 120Hz display at full resolution.

after two months with this galaxy book3 the high-res 1080p webcam makes video calls look so much clearer and the amoled display has deep blacks that are just amazing. it feels like a premium machine for work and the screen colors are incredibly accurate for my design projects.

I needed a reliable laptop for my new remote job and the Galaxy Book 3 felt like the perfect fit right out of the box. The quiet operation under light to moderate workloads is a huge plus for my home office setup. Samsung's customer service was incredibly helpful when I had a question about the display options. While the premium pricing especially for the Ultra and high-storage configurations is steep, the overall quality justifies the cost. It has completely transformed my daily workflow and I honestly do not regret the purchase one bit.

I wanted to love this laptop but honestly have mixed feelings about it. The price is great for the value considering the vibrant color accuracy and deep blacks on AMOLED panels make the display stunning. The keyboard travel and tactile feedback are excellent but the soldered RAM on most models prevents future memory upgrades. You really get a lot of bang for your buck with this machine.

So I finally cracked down and grabbed this Galaxy Book3 for my new home office setup and the display is just stunning. The price point feels totally fair for what you get especially since the build quality is solid enough to last a few years. Customer support was pretty standard nothing to write home about but they did answer my email eventually. I was running a heavy video edit while trying to stay cool in my living room and noticed the fan spinning up way louder than I expected. Honestly though once I settled into a lighter workflow the screen colors are so vibrant and it runs completely silent which is a huge win for me.

Used this daily for 3 months and the color accuracy on the AMOLED panel is just stunning. The thin chassis can lead to thermal throttling under heavy loads, but the price point is still fair for what you get. Samsung support was super helpful when I had some questions about setting up the display. Overall the experience has been great for both work and casual streaming on the go. I did have to wait a few days for a replacement charger to arrive in the mail.

If you are looking for a laptop with stunning visuals, the Galaxy Book3 delivers vibrant color accuracy and deep blacks on its AMOLED panels. My experience with the customer service was smooth and they were very helpful when I had questions about my order. I have been using this machine daily for my graphic design work and it has handled everything I threw at it so far. The pricing is a bit steep if you want the full experience with the higher resolution display and faster processor options. Despite the battery life quirks on the 120Hz models and the basic speakers on the base version, the overall build quality is impressive.

After two months with the Galaxy Book3, the vibrant color accuracy and deep blacks on the AMOLED panel are absolutely stunning. It is incredibly thin and portable, making it easy to toss in my bag for work every single day. The battery life can be inconsistent though, especially when running the high-resolution 120Hz models.

coming from a macbook i was a bit skeptical about this switch but the build quality is honestly exceptional and super thin. the price point is a little steep for what you get though especially if you dont opt for the pro model. customer service was super helpful when i had trouble setting up my account online. i mostly use it for travel since the aluminum chassis feels so durable in my backpack. the speakers on the base model sound pretty flat compared to the pro version but the overall value is still pretty good.

so i picked this up last week and it feels pretty light in my hands. the seamless integration for users who already own galaxy smartphones and tablets is just insane. also the large responsive glass trackpads are super easy to use for everything. just wish the soldered ram on most models prevents future memory upgrades and the base model non-pro uses a standard lcd screen rather than amoled.

Are you tired of dealing with laptops that feel flimsy and look cheap after just a year of use? I have been struggling to find a machine that can keep up with my work while still being easy to carry around. The build quality and thin design are just exceptional, making this device feel incredibly premium in your hands. While the speakers on the base models do lack the depth found in the Pro setups, the high-resolution webcam is a game changer for my video calls. Samsung's service team was also fantastic in helping me set up all the Galaxy features right out of the box.
it really sucks that the base model has a dull lcd screen instead of the vibrant amoled one. the webcam looks crisp and the screen colors are just amazing.
I was so excited to finally get my hands on this laptop after seeing all the specs online. The fast charging capabilities via USB-C are a total game changer for my daily workflow.

Ok so, the seamless integration with my Galaxy phone and tablet is honestly the best part of this laptop. The build quality feels really solid and premium for the price. Just keep in mind the base model screen isn't AMOLED and the battery life can be a bit weird on the 120Hz display.

The keyboard travel and tactile feedback on this machine are absolutely excellent. The premium pricing for the Ultra and high-storage models is honestly a bit much. I picked this up at Best Buy last week while looking for a new laptop for work. Despite the cost, the fast charging capabilities are great, though the base model speakers lack depth.
The seamless integration with my other Galaxy devices is exactly what I needed.

If you already own a Galaxy phone or tablet, the seamless integration is absolutely worth the upgrade. I honestly didn't think I would notice how much it helps until I started using it daily. The price point feels pretty standard for what you are getting with the specs. Be warned though, the glossy screen reflects so much light that it is almost unusable in bright environments.

switching from a macbook, the galaxy book3 price is way better for the features you get. i work from home mostly so video calls are a huge part of my day. the 1080p webcam is great for meetings but the glossy screen gets super reflective in my bright kitchen. overall i love how responsive the glass trackpad is and it makes everything feel so smooth.

Used this daily for 3 months and the seamless integration with my Galaxy phone and the excellent keyboard travel make it a joy to type on. I mainly use it for work while traveling around the country. The speakers on the base models lack the depth found in the Pro setups.
The build quality is exceptional and the thin, portable design makes it incredibly easy to carry everywhere.

So I finally pulled the trigger on the Galaxy Book3 after months of hesitating. Honestly, the premium pricing is a bit of a shock, especially when you look at the Ultra and high-storage configurations. The build quality is solid but I really wish the RAM wasn't soldered on most models since that prevents future memory upgrades. Customer support was actually super helpful when I had questions about the setup. The ecosystem integration with my other Samsung devices just flows so naturally and makes multitasking a breeze. You definitely get what you pay for with the performance and the large, responsive glass trackpads are just amazing. Using it for work every day has been a genuinely positive experience without any major hiccups. The overall construction feels durable enough to last for years of heavy use.

this thing is built like a tank yet feels so light in my hands, and the glass trackpad is incredibly smooth i've been using it for writing reports all week but noticed the screen looks a bit washed out compared to the pro model it also gets pretty warm when i run heavy stuff for too long and the fans start kicking in

Coming from a MacBook, the seamless integration with my Galaxy phone and tablet is exactly what I needed. The premium pricing for the Ultra model and high-storage configurations is steep, though the build quality remains solid.
